subject: Next steps: purchase route, DPA & SOC 2 evidence for Novella Medical
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@novellamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Follow-up & asks from today's discovery — procurement route + SOC 2/DPA

Sarah — thanks again for your time today. High level recap and a few asks so we can accelerate commercial alignment:

- Use case: clinical summarization + notes assistant for outpatient clinics (demo recorded).
- Key gating items you mentioned: procurement path (PO vs. charge card vs. marketplace), executed DPA, and SOC 2 type II evidence for security team.

Action items I can own from Redwood's side (what I'm sending with this note):
- Attached: short SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) and our standard DPA (redwood_standard_dpa.docx).
- If you want, we can pre-fill the DPA with your company name and send via DocuSign — will save you time.
- We'll fill out the Novella security questionnaire your team sent (novella_security_questionnaire.xlsx). Could you confirm the security contact and an expected turnaround?

Procurement route question (one ask so legal/procurement can plan):
- Do you prefer to raise a PO through your AP process, will the purchase be on a company card, or would you prefer to transact via AWS Marketplace (we support both invoice/PO & marketplace billing)?

Possible commercial scaffolding we can offer to unblock a pilot while contracts are finalized:
- 2-week pilot with billable usage invoiced on a short-term PO, or card charge for pilot.
- We can also open a time-limited sandbox with token limits to validate integration.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync next week to align procurement + security + legal. Please let me know a couple windows and who from your side should join.

Thanks — I'll loop Ben (billing) and Karthik (marketplace/ops) as needed.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@novellamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novellamed.com>, Novella Medical Procurement <procurement@novellamed.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up & asks from today's discovery — procurement route + SOC 2/DPA

Thanks, Olga — great session. Quick answers from procurement/security POV:

- Procurement route: for pilots we typically do a short PO (two-week pilot PO) or corporate card. For platform commitments we prefer PO-based agreements. We are evaluating marketplace options but that will need a separate business-case review.
- SOC 2: Security requires SOC 2 Type II report and evidence of encryption at rest. Can you confirm the date of your last SOC 2 Type II and whether the report can be shared under an NDA?
- DPA: Legal will need a redlined DPA; sending the questionnaire to our security analyst (CC'd Liam). Expect an initial turnaround of ~7 business days for the questionnaire and DPA comments.

Procurement contact: procurement@novellamed.com (they manage POs). Security contact: Liam O'Neill (CC'd). Liam — can you confirm if your team needs an encrypted transfer or secure portal for the SOC 2 artifact?

Also, can you provide a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and an expected commercial path options so procurement knows the decision points?

Thanks —
Sarah
Head of Product, Novella Medical
sarah.lim@novellamed.com

Sarah — thanks for the clarity. Short answers and MAP attached: MAP-Novella-20270530.pdf (high level milestones, owners, and dates).

SOC 2 & DPA logistics:
- Last SOC 2 Type II: 2027-03-15 (we can share the report under NDA). We typically provide the artifact over a secure SFTP or SharePoint link; we can also route via your secure portal if preferred.
- I've attached our standard DPA (redwood_standard_dpa.docx). If legal prefers redlines, we will accept them and aim to finalize within ~5 business days of receiving comments. I will send the DPA via DocuSign if you confirm the signatories.

Procurement options to propose internally: (a) Pilot on a two-week PO (we'll invoice), (b) Pilot on corporate card, (c) transact initial production via AWS Marketplace (if you opt for that we'll provide marketplace SKUs & pricing). Ben — quick confirmation on marketplace invoicing and any minimums?

Next steps proposed:
1) Liam/security: confirm preferred transfer method for SOC 2 by EOD tomorrow.
2) Procurement: confirm whether you'll raise a pilot PO or prefer card; if PO, please share PO lead and cadence for approvals.
3) Legal: send DPA comments into the DocuSign thread; we'll aim to turn redlines around in ~5 business days.
4) We will provision a sandbox environment for Novella with token caps by Wednesday to let engineers start integration.

If helpful I can run a 15-min legal/procurement triage to walk through the MAP and the DocuSign packet.

—
Olga Petrov

Olga / Sarah — quick note from billing side:
- Marketplace (AWS) billing is available; no hard minimums for pilot skus, but production commitments via marketplace may have separate invoicing cadence.
- For PO invoicing we'll accept standard Novella PO-numbering and net-30 terms for pilot invoices — Karthik, please confirm if we should approve net-15 for pilots instead.
- For DPA execution we can sign via DocuSign (link Olga shared) and invoice per the PO once countersigned.

Deal reference: RWD-3421-Novella — I'll own invoices and initial billing questions.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
